exact_source: frozen source and target centerlines from maneuver manifest

missingness_rule: zero or ambiguous sign is pre-rollout exclusion
slot_validity_rule: not applicable

exact_source: official original replay ego speed from history buffer

aggregation: median of 10 valid frames
missingness_rule: any missing or nonfinite required frame is pre-rollout exclusion

map_query_rule: no geometry query beyond ego source-lane projection

exact_source: official original replay ego rear axle plus source centerline

map_query_rule: project ego rear axle to frozen source lane centerline at each frame; require same source lane ID for all frames

exact_source: official original replay tracked dynamic vehicles and map lane objects
coordinate_frame: union of source target and immediate adjacent lane corridors
aggregation: median per-frame count of unique valid vehicle track tokens within 50 m projected route distance
missingness_rule: missing track token or failed required lane projection is pre-rollout exclusion
slot_validity_rule: vehicle must be valid and have unique lane projection in every counted frame
map_query_rule: query source target and their native adjacent lane IDs from frozen map version; include only those lanes

exact_source: official original replay tracks passed through tools.stage5d_context_core.assign_stage5d_slots
aggregation: slot bit is one only if valid in at least 8 of 10 frames; bits ordered front__left_front__left_rear__right_front__right_rear
missingness_rule: any frame requiring geometric fallback or an unresolved lane relation is pre-rollout exclusion
slot_validity_rule: slot requires valid tracked object and lane-aware semantic assignment; no slot-ID interpolation
map_query_rule: require map lane query success for all 10 frames; geometric fallback prohibited for exact R1 parity
eligibility_use: exact category match and audit covariate

map_query_rule: query frozen target lane centerline and project ego plus target-side front object uniquely
